sentences.en: After visiting the famous landmark, she experienced some disenchantment.
sentences.zh: 参观了著名的景点之后，她有些失望了。

sentences.en: The initial excitement turned into disenchantment with the new job.
sentences.zh: 最初的兴奋很快变成了对新工作的失望。

sentences.en: His parents' expectations led to his growing disenchantment with college life.
sentences.zh: 父母的期望让他逐渐对大学生活感到失望。
